_source: Gas-phase vibrational fundamentals in cm^-1 from T. Shimanouchi, Tables of Molecular Vibrational Frequencies, Consolidated Volume I, NSRDS-NBS 39 (National Bureau of Standards, 1972), as tabulated in the NIST Chemistry WebBook (SRD 69). H2O: nu1 3657, nu2 1595, nu3 3756. CO2: nu1 1333, nu2 667 (doubly degenerate), nu3 2349.
_janaf: Ideal-gas Cp at 1 bar from M. W. Chase Jr., NIST-JANAF Thermochemical Tables, Fourth Edition, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data, Monograph 9 (1998): H2O (g) 33.590 J/(K mol) at 298.15 K, CO2 (g) 37.129 at 298.15 K and 54.308 at 1000 K. These include anharmonicity and rotation-vibration coupling, which the RRHO model omits.
_generator: platform_nonlinear holds the values of the platform's RRHO function on these inputs, which it evaluated with the nonlinear external term 4R for every molecule, CO2 included.
